name: turbo-upload-scripts
description: Not published. Developer scripts that talk to the Solana devnet, Base Sepolia and the testnet Turbo services. @solana/web3.js builds the SOL top-up transfer, which the package itself deliberately does not do; viem holds the throwaway EVM key for x402 and for the type 3 uploads. Its dependencies are this directory's, never the package's.

scripts.guards: node live-solana-devnet.js --check-guards && node live-base-sepolia-x402.js --check-guards && node live-base-sepolia-type3.js --check-guards
